files..github/workflows/release.yml:
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+"

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with: { fetch-depth: 0, fetch-tags: true }

      - uses: mlugg/setup-zig@v2
        id: setup-zig
        with: { version: 0.15.2 }

      - uses: denoland/setup-deno@v2
        id: setup-deno
        with: { deno-version: v2.x }

      - name: Run tests
        run: zig build test

      - name: Build plugin (ReleaseSmall)
        run: zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseSmall

      - name: Generate release notes
        run: |
          git fetch origin --tags --force
          deno run -A scripts/generate_release_notes.ts "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" > release_notes.md

      - name: Upload plugin artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: plugin
          path: zig-out/bin/plugin.wasm

      - name: Create GitHub release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          files: |
            zig-out/bin/plugin.wasm
            schema.json
          body_path: release_notes.md

  publish-jsr:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - uses: denoland/setup-deno@v2
        id: setup-deno
        with: { deno-version: v2.x }

      - name: Publish to JSR
        run: deno run -A scripts/publish_jsr.ts

  publish-npm:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - uses: denoland/setup-deno@v2
        id: setup-deno
        with: { deno-version: v2.x }

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        id: setup-node
        with: { node-version: 22, registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org }

      - name: Update npm # OIDC provenance requires npm 11.5.1+
        run: npm i -g npm@latest

      - name: Publish to NPM
        run: deno run -A scripts/publish_npm.ts
        # env: # Turned off as we are using OIDC for authentication
        #   NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
files.README.md:
# [dprint-plugin-zig][repo]

[![Release][badge:ci:release]][actions:release] [![JSR][badge:jsr]][jsr]
[![npm][badge:npm]][npm]

A [dprint][dprint] formatting plugin for Zig, written in Zig.

Wraps Zig's built-in [`std.zig.Ast`][zig:std.Ast] formatter in a tiny (~200KB)
WebAssembly module, giving you the official Zig formatting style through
dprint's unified interface.

## Installation

```bash
dprint config add kjanat/zig
```

Or manually add to your `dprint.json`:

```json
{
  "zig": {},
  "plugins": [
    "https://plugins.dprint.dev/kjanat/zig-0.2.1.wasm"
  ]
}
```

## Usage

```bash
dprint fmt "**/*.zig"
```

## Why?

- **Consistent formatting** - Same output as `zig fmt`
- **Unified tooling** - One formatter for Zig, TypeScript, JSON, Markdown, etc.
- **Fast** - Native Wasm execution, no external process spawning
- **Tiny** - ~200KB plugin size

## File Types

- `.zig` - Zig source files
- `.zon` - Zig Object Notation (build.zig.zon, etc.)

## Configuration

Currently uses Zig's default formatting rules with no configuration options.\
The formatter produces identical output to `zig fmt`.

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING][contributing] for build instructions and development info.
